maria: heads-up — onboarding hf/galaxy-7b-q2 shows a weird token-glue regression after we convert the Jinja chat_template -> redwood prompt. eval loss up for instruction-following tests :thinking_face:
kevin: can you paste the template and the converted prompt? maybe it's a sentinel/special-token drop
maria: here's the template we shipped (simplified):
```jinja
{% if system %}- role: system
  content: {{ system | replace('
','\n') }}
{% endif %}
{% for turn in turns %}- role: {{ turn.role }}
  content: {{ turn.content | replace('
','\n') }}
{% endfor %}
```
joel: and the converted prompt?
maria: converted by the onboarder script (rw/hf_chat_to_rw):
```text
- role: system
 content:You are a helpful assistant.
- role: user
 content:Write a 2-sentence summary:Hello world
```
maria: note there's no newline after colon in the system content and user content got glued to the instruction token. tokenizer then creates a single token for "summary:Hello" in q2 quantized model -> LLM outputs drop punctuation
ana: @maria did we preserve special tokens from config.json? sometimes HF models rely on separate sentinels, e.g., "<|system|>" / "<|user|>"
maria: checked config.json: it has `sep_token: "</s>"` and `additional_special_tokens: ["<|system|>", "<|user|>"]` but the conversion script strips them out by default when rendering jinja because the template author used raw strings
kevin: that sounds like two issues: (1) rendering trims whitespace/newlines around jinja blocks -> boundary loss, (2) special tokens not injected before rendering -> tokenization mismatch post-quantization
jeol: quick hack: during conversion, explicitly insert sentinels and ensure newline after role header. e.g. output should be:
```text
<|system|>\nYou are a helpful assistant.\n<|user|>\nWrite a 2-sentence summary:\nHello world\n```
ana: also try running tokenizer.encode on both ref and converted prompt to diff token ids. quantized models (q2/q4) merge weirdly if boundary is missing
kevin: can we add a unit in the onboarder that checks: (a) special tokens present, (b) each role line ends with "\n\n" (or at least newline), (c) numeric tokenization diff < threshold. If fails -> attach transform patch or warn
maria: will prototype a fix. adding a fast check to inject `additional_special_tokens` if not present, and ensure Jinja rendering uses `trim_blocks=False, lstrip_blocks=False` so newlines survive. will post PR
eval-bot: scheduled eval run for hf/galaxy-7b-q2 with new converter on next commit (job 4721). reporting back in ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
